A Summary of a Fitted Model

Source: R/inference.R
StatmodSummary-class.Rd

Holds what summary.StatmodFit() returns: the blocks of each distribution parameter, the degrees of freedom, the information criteria and the notes that qualify the numbers.

Usage

StatmodSummary(
  call = NULL,
  distrib_name = character(0),
  n_obs = integer(0),
  weight_total = integer(0),
  tables = list(),
  classes = list(),
  links = character(0),
  edf = NULL,
  structural = NULL,
  loglik = integer(0),
  df = integer(0),
  aic = integer(0),
  bic = integer(0),
  converged = logical(0),
  elapsed = integer(0),
  level = integer(0),
  vcov_type = vcov_method(),
  test = wald_test(),
  max_coef = NULL,
  notes = character(0),
  certificate = NULL,
  information = NULL,
  bootstrap = NULL
)

Arguments

call

The fit's call.

distrib_name

The distribution's name.

n_obs

The number of rows of the data.

weight_total

The sum of the prior weights, which nobs() reports.

tables

A named list, one entry per distribution parameter, each a list of block records.

classes

The covariance blocks that two or more pieces share (terms, or developments of one term), one block record each. They belong to no equation and are printed ahead of the equations.

links

The link of each distribution parameter, a character vector named by parameter.

edf

The per-term degrees of freedom.

structural

The table of the structural term's parameters, or NULL.

loglik

The conditional log-likelihood at the fit.

df

The effective degrees of freedom in total, including the correction for estimated hyperparameters where it was requested.

aic, bic

The information criteria.

converged

Whether every loop stopped on its own rule.

elapsed

The elapsed time, in seconds.

level

The confidence level at which the intervals were built.

vcov_type

Which variance convention was used.

test

Which statistic the coefficient tables report: "wald", "lr", "score" or "gradient".

max_coef

The number of coefficient rows that each block prints, or NULL where the option statmodels7.summary_max_coef determines it.

notes

A character vector of the notes that qualify the numbers.

certificate

The list returned by statmod_certificate(), or NULL where it could not be computed.

Value

An object of class StatmodSummary.

See also

summary.StatmodFit()

Examples

dd <- data.frame(y = rnorm(30), x = runif(30))
S7::S7_inherits(summary(statmod(y ~ x,
                                distributions7::gaussian1_distrib(), dd)),
                StatmodSummary)
#> [1] TRUE
